entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A dryad mage-student, later graduate instructor, at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A Silverquill student in a relationship with Dina whom she cured after he was fatally injured.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Quandrix student and friend of Dina with whom she blends magics.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A student whose spark ignited during the Invocation of the Founders, causing him to planeswalk away.

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: A student distracted by the compleated Nassari during the Invocation.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A professor who tasked the surviving students with finding the Invocation of the Founders and teaches Introduction to Magibotanical Environments.

entities.name: Dean Lisette
entities.description: A scholar who came to save Dina from the Brittleblight but could not halt the glade's devastation.

entities.name: Professor Onyx
entities.description: A professor in whose potions classroom Dina found a specimen.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: A compleated figure who distracted Rootha during the Invocation.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker who lured four of Dina's students through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker and old acquaintance of Vess who offered to track the students down.

entities.name: Basil
entities.description: A Witherbloom student whose partner Mertyn died and who gave up magical studies.

entities.name: Morphia
entities.description: A Witherbloom student on Dina's field expedition.

entities.name: Lorenin
entities.description: A Witherbloom student on Dina's field expedition.

entities.name: Mertyn
entities.description: Basil's partner, whose death grieved the students and whose revenant the Devotion sent.

entities.name: The Devotion
entities.description: A creature that preys on the grieving, luring students to a saltwater lake.

entities.name: Brittleblight
entities.description: A plague of lethargy and despair that destroyed Dina's glade.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios whose defenses the Phyrexians burned through.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: The college of Strixhaven where Dina studies and teaches.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven lies.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who burned through Strixhaven's defenses during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: A magic activated with a representative from each school to repel the Phyrexian attackers.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A site near which Dina led a field expedition.

events.summary: Dina's glade falls victim to the Brittleblight, and even Dean Lisette cannot halt its devastation.
events.quote: her glade fell victim to the insidious spread of the Brittleblight

events.summary: As a student Dina researches a forbidden resurrection spell and planar travel to find an Esis root to revive the glade.
events.quote: Dina wished to revive the glade and started to research a forbidden resurrection spell.

events.summary: Killian's stray ink magic corrupts Dina's experiment, creating a living swamp monster; they defeat it, Killian is fatally injured, and Dina sacrifices the spell in her blood to cure him.
Dina cures the Brittleblight later that year, though too late for her grove.
events.quote: Dina was able to cure the Brittleblight, although it was too late for her grove.

events.summary: When the Phyrexians invade, Vess sends the surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
events.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

events.summary: The compleated Nassari distracts Rootha, so Quint compensates with raw magic and lifeforce; his spark ignites and he planeswalks away, though the Invocation repels the main wave.
events.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

events.summary: Zimone and Dina blend Quandrix mathematics and Witherbloom biology into new interdisciplinary magic against the invaders.
events.quote: they blended their magics and found to their delight

events.summary: Dina graduates, becomes a teaching assistant, and loses four students lured through an Omenpath by Oko; Ajani offers to track them down.
events.quote: who were lured through an Omenpath by the faerie planeswalker Oko .

events.summary: On an expedition near Titan's Grave, the Devotion lures Basil with Mertyn's revenant; Basil disables the entity's guiding skull.
events.quote: Basil disabled the entity’s guiding skull with a remarkable display of magic

events.summary: Dina recounts the loss of her grove to the students, and Basil relinquishes his magical studies and walks back alone.
